notes:
User is building a spreadsheet to manage contacts from networking events and track follow-ups.

Preferred/evolving columns: Name, Email, Phone, Event, Date, Company, Notes, Follow-up Date, Last Contacted. Company and Last Contacted are especially useful. Optional ideas mentioned but not necessarily adopted: Tags, Relationship/Category, Next Steps, Connection Strength.

Known contacts:
- Rachel: old colleague from the user’s previous company and currently at TechCorp. Previously met at a TechConnect conference on February 10–11; user wants to catch up soon.
- Jason: CEO of StartupX; met at the same TechConnect conference. Wants to discuss potential collaboration. A concise customizable follow-up email template was provided, but no specific company/product/project details were supplied.
- Alex: founder of a new edtech startup; initially met at a WeWork startup mixer. User discovered a shared passion for education and plans to contact him again to learn about the startup and explore collaboration. Suggested questions: target problem, differentiation, stage/growth plans, how the user might contribute, and possible synergies. No date, contact details, startup name, or concrete collaboration plan yet.
- David: user’s friend; met at the same WeWork startup mixer and introduced the user to some Google colleagues. No company/contact details.
- Tom: marketing expert met at a local chamber-of-commerce speed networking event; offered feedback on the startup’s marketing strategy. User wanted suggestions for further marketing resources/experts and advice on following up.
- Dr. Maria Hernandez: informative webinar host in AI/machine learning whom the user attended via a Women in Tech event and plans to contact again. User is interested in current AI/ML learning and especially AI applications in education.
- Jack: BNI member met through weekly BNI networking meetings. He gives valuable feedback on the user’s elevator pitch, while the user advises him on digital marketing. User wants resources/tools to make the pitch clearer and more engaging.

User has met other chamber-event professionals, but they remain unnamed.

Interests/requests: startup marketing, AI/ML courses and trends, AI-powered edtech, networking, pitch development, and digital marketing. Previously suggested cat
